comments.content: The DirectML branch creates a causal_mask without filling with -inf first. This will leave uninitialized memory in the upper triangular part (where triu_(1) sets values to 0), causing incorrect attention masking. Both branches should fill with -inf before triu_(1).

The is_directml_enabled() function references a global 'directml_enabled' variable that is not defined in this file. This will raise a NameError when called. Need to either define the global variable or import it from where it's set.
